summary.text: Chris Waddell is the Democratic candidate for Kentucky House of Representatives District 15, running against incumbent Republican Rebecca Raymer in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A business owner, he says in a Ballotpedia survey that he promotes professional wrestling events in Kentucky.

paragraphs.text: Chris Waddell earned a high school diploma from Muhlenberg High School, and his career experience includes working as a business owner.
In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, Waddell said he was born and raised in Muhlenberg County, Kentucky, in a working-class family.

He wrote that he began community organizing as a child by hosting professional wrestling events in his backyard and that since 2010 he has promoted professional wrestling events weekly in small towns across Kentucky.
Waddell wrote that he is running on "Goodness, Peace and Common Sense" and listed strengthening public education among his priorities.
